name: proto-type-name-unresolved-under-a-buf-module
description: Under a buf.yaml, a file whose imports all resolve but which names a type no scope resolves fails as protoc fails it with its not-defined error: the file publishes nothing and carries a schema-unparsed note. Since a schema file not read cleanly may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
